## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches and the changes comply.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: `cat-doc`, `area:packaging`, and `orig-nv-eng`.

## Affected area

Documentation or samples

## Summary

This is an AI-assisted rewrite of the cuDNN Frontend documentation. It:

- reorganizes the guide around tutorials, task-oriented how-to guides, concepts, and exact API reference material;
- expands graph-construction coverage from declaration through heuristic selection, execution-plan creation, execution, and graph reuse;
- provides paired Python and C++ examples wherever both interfaces support the workflow, including backward examples when applicable;
- consolidates and clarifies attention layouts, masks, precision modes, ragged tensors, graph operations, and supported fusion patterns;
- publishes 247 canonical sample sources and generated snippets instead of duplicating example code;
- inventories 277 individual API pages and 424 family-owned API candidates with source evidence and API-local availability contracts; and
- adds deterministic documentation coverage, generation, and sample-validation checks.

The rewrite used AI assistance for inventory work, restructuring, drafting, cross-language example construction, and review. Technical claims and examples were checked against repository sources, tests, and samples.

Fern-related changes only align this rewrite with the documentation generation and publication mechanism already present in the latest `develop` branch. Fern is supporting build infrastructure, not the primary purpose of this PR.

## Why

The existing documentation had coverage gaps, duplicated or incomplete examples, and inconsistent treatment of Python and C++. This rewrite makes graph workflows easier to learn, makes constraints discoverable at the API level, and gives maintainers deterministic checks for documentation drift.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

No runtime API or binary compatibility changes. The documentation snapshot and compatibility ledger target source commit `0a07d4ee28f8ae2f2106bb766b1878cc732ee80c`.

## Testing

- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python -m pytest tools/doc/tests -q` — 47 passed.
- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python tools/doc/build_doc_manifests.py --check` — 3 manifests current.
- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python tools/doc/build_doc_indexes.py --check` — 300 generated artifacts current.
- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python tools/doc/check_doc_coverage.py --mode release` — 277 APIs, 424 family-owned candidates, and 340 historical-topic dispositions covered.
- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python tools/doc/run_doc_samples.py --list` — 247 canonical samples cataloged.
- Fern validation — 0 errors; the unauthenticated redirect check emitted one expected warning.

Reviewed `f4f3ce6e0c50` against base `84eadd2074fa`.

The canonical-sample and generated-reference structure is useful. I found four localized issues: an unsafe cache example, generation inputs missing from clean checkouts, stale installation/verification metadata, and a rounded BF16 reference that fails in the causal-convolution sample. No P0 or high-risk P1 found in this documentation-only change. Please address these and restore the existing Docs/style checks before merging. CodeQL's non-callable warning for cudnn.ops.causal_conv1d was not reproduced: that entrypoint executes successfully; the sample fails later in its gradient comparison.

**[P2] Include or validate B's dtype and device before reusing the example graph** ([source](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/f4f3ce6e0c502e7ac08154206524e937857d8259/docs/samples/python/pytorch_cached_graph.py#L17))

The cache key records only A's dtype/device. With A=BF16 ones of shape (2,4,8) and B=BF16 twos of shape (1,8,6), the first call correctly returns 16. Replacing only B with B.float() produces the same key; the cached call silently returns alternating 0 and 16 instead of rejecting the incompatible input. A fresh build rejects that combination. This contradicts the integration guide's instruction to key every input's metadata. Include B's dtype/device in the key, or explicitly enforce homogeneous dtype/device before every lookup, and add a warm-cache mismatch regression.

Evidence: Independent SM100 execution of the actual published cached_matmul helper: BF16 control [16,16,16,16,16]; same-key FP32 B [0,16,0,16,0]; fresh graph rejects. Only the documentation helper is added by this PR; no runtime-library regression is attributed here. Attribution: New documentation sample; independently reproduced.

**[P2] Make manifest generation reproducible from a clean checkout** ([source](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/f4f3ce6e0c502e7ac08154206524e937857d8259/tools/doc/build_doc_manifests.py#L1571))

build_old_docs_ledger reads an old_docs/ tree that is not tracked in this PR. In a clean checkout it generates zero topics instead of the committed 340, so build_doc_manifests.py --check fails even with full Git history. The new Docs workflow hits another prerequisite first: checkout@v4's default shallow fetch lacks target_commit 0a07d4e, and source_target_commit raises from git cat-file. The current fern-check run confirms that failure. Track a reproducible historical inventory or reconstruct it from an explicit fetched revision, and fetch the pinned commit (or remove the unnecessary local-object requirement). Test --check from a fresh clone rather than an author workspace containing old_docs/.

Evidence: Local exact-head manifest check exits 1 with DRIFT: docs/old-docs-disposition.json; tracked old_docs files=0, generated topics=0, committed topics=340. Current Docs check https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/actions/runs/40020608709/job/120643887275 fails git cat-file for the pinned commit with exit 128. Attribution: New generator and workflow; independently reproduced plus current CI evidence.

**[P2] Reconcile the installation and verification ledger with the pinned source** ([source](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/f4f3ce6e0c502e7ac08154206524e937857d8259/docs/getting-started/installation.md#L7))

The new guide says Python 3.9, CMake 3.23, pybind11, and optional pinned CUTLASS DSL dependencies. At the stated source target 0a07d4e, pyproject.toml already requires Python >=3.10 and CUTLASS DSL >=4.6.2, the root CMake minimum is 3.26, and the binding build uses nanobind. docs/compatibility.json additionally says the extra pins DSL 4.5.0, while verification.md labels this checkout FE 1.27.0 although that pinned commit declares 1.32.0. Update the source-owned requirements and regenerate the repeated availability blocks; keep any historical verification environment explicitly separate from the current source/support contract.

Evidence: Read current and commit-pinned pyproject.toml, CMakeLists.txt and python/cudnn/__init__.py; the native environment probe resolves this PR's Python source and reports FE 1.32.0. The stale DSL statement is propagated by compatibility.json into generated reference pages. Attribution: New documentation claims disagree with their own pinned source.

**[P2] Use a sufficiently precise oracle for the causal-convolution gradient example** ([source](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/f4f3ce6e0c502e7ac08154206524e937857d8259/docs/samples/python/causal_conv1d.py#L55))

This executable sample fails the bias-gradient assertion on SM100 with cuDNN 9.27: one of 128 values differs by 0.0620117 against atol=0.05. Its reference computes conv1d and SiLU separately in BF16, introducing an intermediate rounding that the fused implementation need not share. In a separate probe on the same seeded inputs, computing the reference and gradients in FP32 passes the existing rtol/atol=0.05 checks for dx, dw and db. Please use the higher-precision oracle with explicit dtype handling and run through the later torch.compile section on a build that exposes the bindings; syntax fallback cannot qualify these numerical assertions. This is a sample/reference issue, not evidence of a newly introduced kernel bug.

Evidence: Native exact-head sample runner: causal_conv1d fails at gradient comparison, while five other selected Python examples pass. +        groups=x.shape[1],
+    )
+    return F.silu(y) if activation == "silu" else y
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(7)
+    batch, channels, sequence, kernel_size = 2, 128, 256, 4
+    x = torch.randn(
+        batch,
+        channels,
+        sequence,
+        device="cuda",
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        requires_grad=True,
+    )
+    weight = torch.randn(
+        channels,
+        kernel_size,
+        device="cuda",
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        requires_grad=True,
+    )
+    bias = torch.randn(
+        channels,
+        device="cuda",
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        requires_grad=True,
+    )
+
+    causal_conv1d = getattr(cudnn.ops, "causal_conv1d")
+    actual = causal_conv1d(x, weight, bias, activation="silu")

Reviewed `665c9a496aa5` against base `35150c04f317`.

Thank you for your contribution! Rechecked the update: the four earlier findings are addressed, and the custom operator's fake broadcast shape now works in compiled execution. Documentation generation and current Docs/style checks pass. One localized P2 remains in the newly exercised broadcast backward example; no P0 or high-risk P1 found. My existing approval stands.

**[P2] Keep broadcast-gradient partials in FP32 until after the batch reduction** ([source](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/665c9a496aa5b0ffcbc478eff1fcaf71f4518717/docs/samples/python/pytorch_custom_operator.py#L82))

The updated executable sample still fails at line 108 on SM100. With its own seed 11 and A[1,32,64], B[2,64,48], grad_a[0,23,24] is 0.0625 versus torch.matmul's 0.099609375 (independent FP32 oracle: 0.09945142), exceeding the existing rtol/atol=0.03. The per-batch matmul is materialized in BF16 before sum_to_size, so cancellation happens after rounding the partials. Reversing the broadcast direction also exposes this in grad_b. Please perform the gradient matmul and sum_to_size in FP32, then convert the final gradient to the corresponding input dtype, or use an equivalent accumulation strategy. An independent probe of that formula passes both directions at the unchanged tolerances. This is a sample/backward precision issue, not a new cuDNN kernel defect; the fake-shape fix and compiled forward both pass.

Evidence: Native exact-head sample fails 1/2048 gradient-A elements; reversed broadcast probe fails 2/3072 gradient-B elements. FP32 accumulation through the batch reduction reduces the maximum difference from Torch's BF16 gradients to 0 and 3.814697e-6 respectively. Existing numerical tolerances were not widened. Attribution: Newly exercised broadcast case and backward reduction in this follow-up; independently reproduced.

Validation: 47 documentation-tool tests passed; both manifest checks, all 300 generated artifacts, and release coverage pass. The 247-entry sample catalog is intact. Exact-head native validation on SM100 with Torch 2.14.1+cu130, CUDA 13.0, CUTLASS DSL 4.8.0 and cuDNN 9.27: cached matmul, causal convolution (eager/backward/compile), and serialization examples pass. The custom-op example has the localized gradient failure above; its compiled forward passes in both broadcast directions. Both updated graph-cache helpers reject a warm-cache BF16-to-FP32 change in B explicitly and continue to execute correctly when B returns to BF16. Confirmed the frozen historical ledger removes the missing old_docs dependency, and installation metadata now matches the stated source contract. Reviewed changes since the prior head, including the substantive sample/tooling edits; most other source changes are formatting/license headers. Runtime-library implementations are unchanged. Current Docs, pre-commit and CodeQL checks pass; no redundant GPU CI run requested.

Limitations: Focused follow-up validation, not native execution of all 247 samples or qualification of every documented platform. Existing compatible compiled bindings were used with verified PR Python source. No new application-performance or determinism claim. The gradient discrepancy above concerns intermediate rounding, not observed run-to-run nondeterminism.

## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches and the changes comply.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: `cat-doc`, `area:packaging`, and `orig-nv-eng`.

## Affected area

Documentation or samples

## Summary

This is an AI-assisted rewrite of the cuDNN Frontend documentation. It:

- reorganizes the guide around tutorials, task-oriented how-to guides, concepts, and exact API reference material;
- expands graph-construction coverage from declaration through heuristic selection, execution-plan creation, execution, and graph reuse;
- provides paired Python and C++ examples wherever both interfaces support the workflow, including backward examples when applicable;
- consolidates and clarifies attention layouts, masks, precision modes, ragged tensors, graph operations, and supported fusion patterns;
- publishes 247 canonical sample sources and generated snippets instead of duplicating example code;
- inventories 277 individual API pages and 424 family-owned API candidates with source evidence and API-local availability contracts; and
- adds deterministic documentation coverage, generation, and sample-validation checks.

The rewrite used AI assistance for inventory work, restructuring, drafting, cross-language example construction, and review. Technical claims and examples were checked against repository sources, tests, and samples.

Fern-related changes only align this rewrite with the documentation generation and publication mechanism already present in the latest `develop` branch. Fern is supporting build infrastructure, not the primary purpose of this PR.

## Why

The existing documentation had coverage gaps, duplicated or incomplete examples, and inconsistent treatment of Python and C++. This rewrite makes graph workflows easier to learn, makes constraints discoverable at the API level, and gives maintainers deterministic checks for documentation drift.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

No runtime API or binary compatibility changes. The documentation snapshot and compatibility ledger target source commit `0a07d4ee28f8ae2f2106bb766b1878cc732ee80c`.

## Testing

- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python -m pytest tools/doc/tests -q` — 47 passed.
- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python tools/doc/build_doc_manifests.py --check` — 3 manifests current.
- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python tools/doc/build_doc_indexes.py --check` — 300 generated artifacts current.
- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python tools/doc/check_doc_coverage.py --mode release` — 277 APIs, 424 family-owned candidates, and 340 historical-topic dispositions covered.
- `PYENV_VERSION=pt python tools/doc/run_doc_samples.py --list` — 247 canonical samples cataloged.
- Fern validation — 0 errors; the unauthenticated redirect check emitted one expected warning.

+# autotune
+
+Execute built candidate plans, measure runtime, and select the fastest plan.
+
+## C++ synopsis
+
+```cpp
+auto status = graph.autotune(handle, variant_pack, workspace);
+```
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `handle` (`cudnnHandle_t`, required): cuDNN handle used for candidate execution and CUDA timing events.
+
+- `tensor_uid_to_pointer_map` (`std::unordered_map<int64_t, void*>&`, required overload): Runtime variant pack keyed by tensor UID.
+
+- `tensor_to_pointer_map` (`std::unordered_map<std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>, void*>&`, required overload): Runtime variant pack keyed by tensor attributes. The overload converts tensor keys to UIDs before autotuning.
+
+- `workspace` (`void*`, required): Device workspace large enough for any candidate plan that autotune may execute. The canonical sample uses checked per-plan workspace queries because the current `get_autotune_workspace_size()` implementation can dereference failed-plan slots.
+
+- `user_impl` (`void*`, optional, default `nullptr`): Reserved for future use by the implementation.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `status` (`fe::error_t`): `OK` when autotune completes. Individual candidate failures during warmup or timed iterations are skipped; the method still succeeds if it can process the plan list.
+
+## Errors
+
+The returned `error_t` can report failures from `execute_plan_at_index()`, invalid variant packs, CUDA event or stream failures, missing or invalid built plans, or other CUDA/cuDNN backend failures. Check `status.is_good()` before executing the selected plan.

+# diagonal_band_mask
+
+Append a diagonal-band masking operation to an attention score tensor.
+
+## C++ synopsis
+
+```cpp
+auto masked_scores = graph.diagonal_band_mask(
+    scores,
+    negative_inf,
+    seq_len_q,
+    seq_len_kv,
+    cu_seq_len_q,
+    cu_seq_len_kv,
+    left_bound,
+    shift_right_bound,
+    fe::graph::DiagonalBandMask_attributes());
+```
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `x` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`, required): Input score tensor to mask. The output shape and stride default to this tensor's shape and stride.
+
+- `b` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`, required): Fill value tensor used when a score is masked. For attention masks this is normally a scalar or tensor containing negative infinity.
+
+- `seq_len_q` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`, optional): Query sequence lengths used to adjust the diagonal relation for variable-length attention.
+
+- `seq_len_kv` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`, optional): Key/value sequence lengths used to adjust the diagonal relation for variable-length attention.
+
+- `cu_seq_len_q` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`, optional): Cumulative query sequence offsets for packed variable-length attention.
+
+- `cu_seq_len_kv` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`, optional): Cumulative key/value sequence offsets for packed variable-length attention.
+
+- `left_bound` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`, optional): Left sliding-window bound. When provided, the mask compares the shifted column index against the row index.
+
+- `shift_right_bound` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`, optional): Nonzero right-bound shift used for causal or chunked-prefill masking. A causal right bound of zero is represented by leaving this as `nullptr`. This must not be specified together with `left_bound`.
+
+- `attributes` (`fe::graph::DiagonalBandMask_attributes`, required): Attribute object defined in `include/cudnn_frontend/graph_properties.h`.
+
+- `attributes.set_comparison_mode(fe::PointwiseMode_t)`: Optional comparison mode for the generated mask. The default is `CMP_GT`.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `Y` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`): Masked output tensor attributes. If shape or stride are unset, they are inferred from `x`.
+
+## Errors
+
+`Graph::diagonal_band_mask()` appends a node and returns tensor attributes. `validate()` reports `INVALID_VALUE` if both `left_bound` and `shift_right_bound` are specified. Tensor metadata errors and backend failures are reported by later lifecycle calls.
+

+# matmul
+
+Append a matrix multiplication operation to a C++ frontend graph.
+
+## C++ synopsis
+
+```cpp
+std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>
+fe::graph::Graph::matmul(
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> A,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> B,
+    fe::graph::Matmul_attributes attributes);
+```
+
+Typical use:
+
+```cpp
+auto C = graph->matmul(
+    A,
+    B,
+    fe::graph::Matmul_attributes()
+        .set_name("matmul")
+        .set_compute_data_type(fe::DataType_t::FLOAT)
+        .set_padding_value(0.0f));
+```
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `A` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): Left input tensor. The
+  innermost logical dimension is the contracting `K` dimension; the preceding
+  dimension is `M`.
+
+- `B` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): Right input tensor. The
+  second-to-last logical dimension is the contracting `K` dimension and must
+  match `A`; the last dimension is `N`.
+
+- `attributes` (`fe::graph::Matmul_attributes`, required): Attribute object
+  defined in `include/cudnn_frontend/graph_properties.h`.
+
+- `attributes.set_compute_data_type(fe::DataType_t)`: Sets the accumulation and
+  compute type. Mixed-precision examples commonly use `FLOAT`.
+
+- `attributes.set_padding_value(float)`: Sets the value used by padded backend
+  matmul paths. Dense examples normally use `0.0f`.
+
+- `attributes.set_name(std::string)`: Sets the operation name.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `C` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`): Output tensor attributes for the
+  matmul result. The inferred logical shape is usually the broadcast batch shape
+  followed by `(M, N)`. Mark it as an output and set the desired IO dtype when it
+  must be written by `execute()`.

+
+`Graph::matmul` appends the node and returns tensor attributes. Shape, dtype,
+layout, and support failures are reported later through lifecycle `error_t`

+# resample
+
+Append a resampling or pooling forward operation to the graph.
+
+## C++ synopsis
+
+```cpp
+auto [Y, Index] = graph.resample(
+    X,
+    fe::graph::Resample_attributes()
+        .set_generate_index(false)
+        .set_resampling_mode(fe::ResampleMode_t::MAXPOOL)
+        .set_padding_mode(fe::PaddingMode_t::NEG_INF_PAD)
+        .set_window({2, 2})
+        .set_stride({2, 2})
+        .set_pre_padding({0, 0})
+        .set_post_padding({0, 0}));
+```
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `X` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`, required): Input tensor. The first two dimensions are treated as batch and channel dimensions; remaining dimensions are spatial dimensions.
+
+- `attributes` (`fe::graph::Resample_attributes`, required): Attribute object defined in `include/cudnn_frontend/graph_properties.h`.
+
+- `attributes.set_generate_index(bool)`: Required. When `true` and the resampling mode is `MAXPOOL`, the operation returns an index tensor in addition to `Y`. When `false`, the returned `Index` pointer is `nullptr`.
+
+- `attributes.set_resampling_mode(fe::ResampleMode_t)`: Required. Supported enum values include `AVGPOOL_EXCLUDE_PADDING`, `AVGPOOL_INCLUDE_PADDING`, `BILINEAR`, `NEAREST`, and `MAXPOOL`, subject to cuDNN backend support.
+
+- `attributes.set_padding_mode(fe::PaddingMode_t)`: Required padding behavior, such as `NEG_INF_PAD`, `ZERO_PAD`, or `EDGE_VAL_PAD`, subject to the selected resampling mode.
+
+- `attributes.set_window(...)`, `attributes.set_stride(...)`, `attributes.set_pre_padding(...)`, and `attributes.set_post_padding(...)`: Spatial vectors. Integer overloads are converted to `cudnnFraction_t` values with denominator `1`; fractional overloads can be used for modes that need fractional parameters.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `Y` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`): Output tensor attributes. If dimensions are not set explicitly, the frontend infers spatial output dimensions as `1 + (input + pre_padding + post_padding - window) / stride`.
+
+- `Index` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`): Max-pooling index tensor attributes when `generate_index == true` and the mode is `MAXPOOL`; otherwise `nullptr`.
+
+## Errors
+
+`Graph::resample()` appends a node and returns tensor attributes. Missing `generate_index`, invalid resampling mode, unsupported padding/mode combinations, malformed tensor metadata, or backend failures are reported by later graph lifecycle `error_t` statuses.

+# sdpa
+
+Build a scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) operation in a cuDNN frontend C++
+graph.
+
+## C++ synopsis
+
+```cpp
+#include <cudnn_frontend.h>
+
+namespace fe = cudnn_frontend;
+
+std::array<std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>, 2>
+fe::graph::Graph::sdpa(
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> q,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> k,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> v,
+    fe::graph::SDPA_attributes attributes);
+```
+
+Typical use:
+
+```cpp
+auto sdpa_options = fe::graph::SDPA_attributes()
+                        .set_name("flash_attention")
+                        .set_generate_stats(true)
+                        .set_attn_scale(1.0f / std::sqrt(static_cast<float>(d_qk)))
+                        .set_diagonal_alignment(fe::DiagonalAlignment_t::TOP_LEFT)
+                        .set_diagonal_band_right_bound(0)
+                        .set_compute_data_type(fe::DataType_t::FLOAT);
+
+auto [O, Stats] = graph->sdpa(Q, K, V, sdpa_options);
+```
+
+`sdpa` computes:
+
+```text
+scores = matmul(q, transpose(k))
+scores = scores * attn_scale              # only when attn_scale is provided
+scores = score_mod(scores)                # optional score modifier function
+scores = scores + bias                    # optional
+scores = scores + alibi / diagonal mask   # optional additive term
+scores = scores + padding mask            # optional additive term
+Stats = logsumexp(scores)                 # only when generate_stats=true
+probs = softmax(scores)
+probs = dropout(probs)                    # optional; applied after softmax
+O = matmul(probs, v)
+```
+
+Equivalently, with optional score modifier function $f$, additive bias $B$,
+optional additive ALiBi/diagonal mask term $M_d$, and optional additive padding
+mask term $M_p$:
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+S &= QK^\top, \\
+\hat{S} &= f\left(\alpha S\right) + B + M_d + M_p, \\
+\operatorname{Stats} &= \operatorname{logsumexp}\left(\hat{S}\right), \\
+P &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\hat{S}\right), \\
+\tilde{P} &= \operatorname{dropout}\left(P\right), \\
+O &= \tilde{P}V.
+\end{aligned}
+$$
+
+Here $\alpha$ is `attn_scale` when provided; otherwise the multiplication by
+$\alpha$ is omitted. $\operatorname{Stats}$ is generated only when
+`attributes.set_generate_stats(true)` is used; its `logsumexp` reduction is
+taken over the last score dimension, corresponding to the key/value sequence
+positions. Terms for disabled options are omitted. Additive mask terms use `0`
+for retained scores and a large negative value or negative infinity for masked
+scores. When dropout is disabled, $\tilde{P} = P$; when enabled, dropout is
+applied to the softmax probabilities before the multiplication by $V$.
+
+The operation appends nodes to `graph` and returns graph tensor attributes. It
+does not execute immediately; validate, build, and execute the graph in the
+usual C++ frontend workflow.
+
+## Parameters
+
+Core parameters:
+
+- `q` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`, required): Query tensor
+  attributes. Must be 4-D with logical shape `(B, H_q, S_q, D_qk)`. The last
+  stride, corresponding to the head dimension, must be `1`. For the standard
+  FP16/BF16 `sdpa` path, `D_qk` must be a multiple of `8`. See Notes for
+  architecture- and cuDNN-version-specific maximums.
+
+- `k` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`, required): Key tensor
+  attributes. Usually shape `(B, H_k, S_kv, D_qk)`. With paged attention, this is
+  the key-cache container rather than the logical dense K tensor. Its head
+  dimension must match `q`'s `D_qk`, which must be a multiple of `8` for the
+  standard FP16/BF16 path.
+
+- `v` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`, required): Value tensor
+  attributes. Usually shape `(B, H_v, S_kv, D_v)`. With paged attention, this is
+  the value-cache container. For the standard FP16/BF16 `sdpa` path, `D_v` must
+  be a multiple of `8`.
+
+- `attributes` (`fe::graph::SDPA_attributes`, required): Attribute object that
+  carries all optional SDPA inputs, outputs, masks, score transformations, and
+  implementation choices. `SDPA_attributes` is defined in
+  `include/cudnn_frontend/graph_properties.h`. The public C++ `Graph::sdpa`
+  overload takes this object by value and returns only `{O, Stats}` for backward
+  compatibility, even though `SDPA_attributes` also defines an internal
+  `SDPA_outputs` convenience struct.
+
+`SDPA_attributes` setters:
+
+- `attributes.set_name(std::string const& name)`: Sets the operation name used
+  to name generated tensors, for example `"<name>::O"` and
+  `"<name>::Stats"`.
+
+- `attributes.set_generate_stats(bool value)`: Controls whether `Stats` is
+  created. Use `true` for training when `sdpa_backward` will need softmax
+  statistics. Use `false` for inference. In C++, omitting this setter behaves
+  like `false` for the public return value, but new code should set it
+  explicitly for readability and to match the Python binding.
+
+- `attributes.set_attn_scale(float value)` or
+  `attributes.set_attn_scale(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)`: Sets an
+  optional scale multiplied into the attention scores after `Q @ K.T`. cuDNN
+  does not infer `1 / sqrt(D_qk)`; pass it explicitly when desired. If a tensor
+  is used, it is commonly scalar-shaped and pass-by-value. Do not set both the
+  float and tensor forms; validation reports `ATTRIBUTE_NOT_SET` for that
+  conflict.
+
+- `attributes.set_bias(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)`: Adds an
+  optional score bias broadcast-compatible with `(B, H_q, S_q, S_kv)`, commonly
+  `(1, H_q, S_q, S_kv)` or `(B, 1, S_q, S_kv)`. Boolean bias tensors are not
+  supported.
+
+- `attributes.set_block_mask(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)`: Adds an
+  optional packed block mask input. The common tile form is `UINT8` with shape
+  `(B, H_q, ceil(S_q / 128), ceil(ceil(S_kv / 128) / 8))`. Requires an
+  implementation and cuDNN version that support block masks. Do not force
+  `fe::AttentionImplementation_t::COMPOSITE` when `block_mask` is provided; the
+  composite implementation does not support `block_mask`. On SM10x, unified
+  SDPA block masks require cuDNN 9.26 or newer because older backends have a
+  masked-tile initialization bug.
+
+- `attributes.set_alibi_mask(bool value)`: Enables ALiBi score offsets. In the
+  FP16/BF16 support surface, ALiBi requires
+  `attributes.set_diagonal_band_right_bound(0)`.
+
+- `attributes.set_padding_mask(bool value)`: Enables variable sequence length
+  masking. If this is `true`, both `set_seq_len_q` and `set_seq_len_kv` are
+  required. If this is `false`, do not set sequence length tensors unless a
+  custom score modifier function consumes them.
+
+- `attributes.set_seq_len_q(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)` and
+  `attributes.set_seq_len_kv(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)`: Set
+  actual query and key/value sequence length tensors. They are normally `INT32`
+  tensors with shape `{B, 1, 1, 1}` and stride `{1, 1, 1, 1}`. They are used
+  with padding masks, paged attention, ragged layouts, or custom score modifier
+  functions that need sequence lengths.
+
+- `attributes.set_dropout(float probability, seed, offset)`: Enables internally
+  generated Philox dropout. `probability` is the drop probability and cannot be
+  `1.0`. `seed` and `offset` are scalar graph tensors, commonly shape
+  `{1, 1, 1, 1}` and stride `{1, 1, 1, 1}`; repository C++ samples use `INT32`
+  tensors. Dropout is applied after softmax and before multiplication by `V`.
+
+- `attributes.set_dropout(mask, scale)`: Enables externally supplied dropout.
+  The current C++ header order is `(mask, scale)`. `mask` should have the
+  attention score shape `(B, H_q, S_q, S_kv)`, or the paged maximum KV length in
+  the last dimension when paged attention uses an explicit maximum. `scale` is
+  commonly a scalar pass-by-value `FLOAT` tensor containing
+  `1 / (1 - probability)`. Do not combine this overload with probability-based
+  dropout.
+
+- `attributes.set_rng_dump(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)`: Sets an
+  optional output tensor for dumping the generated dropout RNG mask. This is for
+  debugging and is used only with probability-based dropout. Its shape should
+  match the attention score matrix `(B, H_q, S_q, S_kv)`, or
+  `(B, H_q, S_q, max_seq_len_kv)` when paged attention uses
+  `set_paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv`. The usual contiguous stride is
+  `{H_q * S_q * S_kv, S_q * S_kv, S_kv, 1}`, with `S_kv` replaced by
+  `max_seq_len_kv` for paged attention. The data type should be `FLOAT`. The
+  public `Graph::sdpa` return array does not include this tensor, so keep the
+  pointer and UID you pass to `set_rng_dump`.
+
+- `attributes.set_paged_attention_k_table(value)` and
+  `attributes.set_paged_attention_v_table(value)`: Set page tables for looking
+  up blocks in the key and value cache containers. Page table tensors are
+  normally `INT32` with shape `{B, 1, table_size, 1}` and stride
+  `{table_size, table_size, 1, 1}`. Values in both K and V tables are `INT32`
+  block indices into their corresponding cache containers.
+
+- `attributes.set_paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv(int value)`: Sets the logical
+  maximum KV sequence length when paged attention is active. Do not set this
+  unless `set_paged_attention_k_table` or `set_paged_attention_v_table` is used.
+  If set, the last dimension of bias and `rng_dump` tensors must match this
+  value.
+
+- `attributes.set_compute_data_type(fe::DataType_t value)`: Sets the compute
+  type for this operation. When left as `NOT_SET`, the graph-level compute type
+  is used. For the unified implementation, compute type must be `FLOAT`.
+
+- `attributes.set_implementation(fe::AttentionImplementation_t value)`: Selects
+  the attention implementation. `AUTO` chooses a supported `COMPOSITE` or
+  `UNIFIED` path. The explicit choices have different feature, version, and
+  architecture support surfaces.
+
+- `attributes.set_score_mod(fn)`: Installs a custom score modifier function.
+  `fn` must be callable as
+  `std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>(std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Graph>, std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>)`.
+  The function receives a temporary score-modifier graph and the raw score
+  tensor, then returns the modified score tensor. In the FP16/BF16 support
+  surface, do not combine `score_mod` with the built-in ALiBi, padding, causal,
+  or sliding-window masking setters.
+
+- `attributes.set_logit_max(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)` and
+  `attributes.set_score_sum_exp(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)`: Set
+  optional user-provided output tensors for the softmax logit maximum and the
+  numerically stable sum of exponentials. Shapes are normally `(B, H_q, S_q, 1)`
+  and data type `FLOAT`. They are filled through graph execution but are not
+  returned by `Graph::sdpa`.
+
+- `attributes.set_sink_token(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes> value)`: Sets an
+  optional sink-attention token tensor. Shape is `(1, H_q, 1, 1)`, stride is
+  commonly `{H_q, 1, 1, 1}`, and data type is `FLOAT`.
+
+- `attributes.set_unfuse_fma(bool value)`: SM100 softmax option. When `true`,
+  uses unfused `__fmul_rn` plus `__fadd_rn` instead of fused FMA in selected
+  softmax paths. Backend support is version-specific.
+
+Preferred masking setters:
+
+- `attributes.set_diagonal_alignment(fe::DiagonalAlignment_t alignment)`: Sets
+  the alignment used by diagonal band masks. `TOP_LEFT` is the standard prefill
+  alignment. `BOTTOM_RIGHT` is used for bottom-right aligned decode masks and
+  variable-length diagonal alignment.
+
+- `attributes.set_diagonal_band_left_bound(int value)`: Sets an optional left
+  sliding-window bound. The value is an offset to the left of the main diagonal
+  that remains visible. Do not use this together with deprecated
+  `set_sliding_window_length`; they configure the same left-bound masking
+  behavior.
+
+- `attributes.set_diagonal_band_right_bound(int value)`: Sets an optional right
+  diagonal bound. `0` with `TOP_LEFT` alignment is the preferred causal-mask
+  spelling. Do not use this together with deprecated `set_causal_mask` or
+  `set_causal_mask_bottom_right`; those setters also set the right bound to `0`.
+
+Deprecated setters:
+
+- `attributes.set_sliding_window_length(int value)`: Deprecated. Equivalent to
+  `set_diagonal_band_left_bound(value)`. Do not combine both spellings.
+
+- `attributes.set_causal_mask(bool value)`: Deprecated. When `value` is `true`,
+  equivalent to `set_diagonal_alignment(TOP_LEFT)` and
+  `set_diagonal_band_right_bound(0)`. Do not combine it with
+  `set_causal_mask_bottom_right` or an explicit right bound.
+
+- `attributes.set_causal_mask_bottom_right(bool value)`: Deprecated. When
+  `value` is `true`, equivalent to `set_diagonal_alignment(BOTTOM_RIGHT)` and
+  `set_diagonal_band_right_bound(0)`. Do not combine it with
+  `set_causal_mask` or an explicit right bound.
+
+- `attributes.set_is_inference(bool value)`: Deprecated compatibility option.
+  `set_is_inference(false)` maps to `set_generate_stats(true)`;
+  `set_is_inference(true)` maps to `set_generate_stats(false)`. Prefer
+  `set_generate_stats`.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `O` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`): Output tensor
+  attributes for the attention result. The logical output shape is
+  `(B, H_q, S_q, D_v)`, where `D_v` must be a multiple of `8` for the standard
+  FP16/BF16 path. The returned tensor is virtual until it is marked as a graph
+  output with `O->set_output(true)`. Set its dimensions, strides, data type when
+  needed, and UID before graph validation/build.
+
+- `Stats` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`):
+  Softmax statistics tensor. Present only when
+  `attributes.set_generate_stats(true)` is used; otherwise `Stats == nullptr`.
+  The usual shape is `(B, H_q, S_q, 1)` and data type is `FLOAT`. These
+  statistics are required by `sdpa_backward`.
+
+## Errors
+
+- `std::runtime_error`: `Graph::sdpa` can throw immediately when
+  `attributes.set_implementation(AUTO)` cannot find a suitable implementation
+  for the current `SDPA_attributes`. The thrown message is
+  `"No suitable implementation for given SDPA_attributes"`.
+
+- `cudnn_frontend::error_t`: Most C++ frontend failures are returned later by
+  graph methods such as `validate`, `build_operation_graph`,
+  `create_execution_plans`, `check_support`, `build_plans`, `build`,
+  `get_workspace_size`, and `execute`. Check `status.is_good()` or
+  `status.is_bad()`, then inspect `status.get_code()` and
+  `status.get_message()`.
+
+- `error_code_t::ATTRIBUTE_NOT_SET`: Returned for missing required tensor
+  attributes or invalid option combinations such as setting both tensor and
+  float attention scale, enabling padding mask without both sequence length
+  tensors, setting sequence length tensors without padding mask or score
+  modifier usage, combining custom and probability-based dropout, or using
+  dropout probability `1.0`.
+
+- `error_code_t::INVALID_VALUE`: Returned for value-level validation failures,
+  such as a negative right diagonal bound or an invalid left bound on cuDNN
+  versions that require positive left bounds.
+
+- `error_code_t::GRAPH_NOT_SUPPORTED`: Returned when the graph is well-formed
+  but unsupported by the selected implementation, cuDNN version, GPU
+  architecture, data type, tensor dimensions, mask combination, paged-attention
+  configuration, or feature support surface.
+

+  `SHAPE_DEDUCTION_FAILED`, `INVALID_TENSOR_NAME`, `INVALID_VARIANT_PACK`,
+  `GRAPH_EXECUTION_PLAN_CREATION_FAILED`, `HEURISTIC_QUERY_FAILED`,
+  `GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAILED`, `CUDA_API_FAILED`, `CUDNN_BACKEND_API_FAILED`,
+  `INVALID_CUDA_DEVICE`, `HANDLE_ERROR`, or `NVRTC_COMPILATION_FAILED`,
+  depending on which frontend, backend, CUDA, or optional OSS engine stage

+- `sdpa` is a graph-construction API. It returns tensor attributes, not device
+  pointers, device tensors, or computed data.

+- `Graph::sdpa` is the standard FP16/BF16 forward path. If
+  `SDPA_attributes` does not set an internal MMA core mode, `Graph::sdpa` sets it
+  to `DataType_t::HALF`. This path does not support FP32 Q, K, V, or O tensors
+  as a public support surface. Use `FLOAT` for compute and auxiliary tensors
+  such as `Stats`, `rng_dump`, `score_max`, `score_sum_exp`, and `sink_token`.

+
+- Q, K, V, and O are normally all FP16 or all BF16 in the standard path. Their
+  strides do not need to be identical, and repository examples use different
+  valid layouts for inputs and outputs. The last stride of Q, K, V, and O must
+  be `1`.
+
+- GQA/MQA requires `H_q % H_k == 0` and `H_q % H_v == 0`.
+
+- `D_qk` and `D_v` must be multiples of `8` for the standard FP16/BF16 path. The
+  separate FP8 SDPA entry points have stricter dimension rules, generally
+  requiring multiples of `16` plus architecture/version-specific maximums.
+
+- For the standard FP16/BF16 `sdpa` path, maximum head dimension limits are
+  architecture- and cuDNN-version-specific. On Ampere (SM80), `D_qk` and `D_v`
+  must be `<= 128` for cuDNN `<= 9.9.0`. On Hopper (SM90), they must be
+  `<= 256` for cuDNN `<= 9.9.0`. On Blackwell (SM100), they must be `<= 128`
+  for cuDNN `< 9.9.0`. For newer cuDNN versions, this frontend check does not
+  impose an additional hard maximum beyond the multiple-of-8 requirement, but
+  backend plan selection may still reject unsupported shapes.
+
+- For the separate FP8 SDPA entry points, Hopper requires `D_qk` and `D_v` to be
+  `<= 256` and multiples of `16`. Blackwell generally requires `D_qk` and `D_v`
+  to be `<= 128` and multiples of `16`, with a cuDNN `>= 9.19.0` exception for
+  `D_qk = 192` and `D_v = 128`.
+
+- `attn_scale` is optional. If it is not set, scores are not scaled. This is not
+  equivalent to automatically using `1 / sqrt(D_qk)`.
+
+- If `padding_mask` is enabled, both `seq_len_q` and `seq_len_kv` are required.
+  Paged attention also requires both sequence length tensors.
+
+- Ragged or THD tensors are represented by setting ragged offsets on
+  `Tensor_attributes` through `set_ragged_offset`. Ragged SDPA is supported only
+  with padding-mask semantics or a custom score modifier that consumes sequence
+  lengths. The C++ paged decode/prefill sample stores Q ragged offsets as
+  element offsets of length `B + 1`.
+
+- `block_mask` is a coarse, tile-level score mask for block-sparse attention
+  patterns. The tensor is `UINT8`; each byte packs 8 adjacent KV tiles for a
+  given batch, query head, and query tile. With standard `128 x 128` SDPA tiles,
+  the shape is `(B, H_q, ceil(S_q / 128), ceil(ceil(S_kv / 128) / 8))`. A set
+  bit keeps the corresponding score tile, while an unset bit masks that tile by
+  adding negative infinity before softmax. Padded tile entries outside the
+  logical `(S_q, S_kv)` score matrix are ignored. Repository samples gate this
+  path to cuDNN `>= 9.14` and Blackwell-class hardware; the composite
+  implementation does not support `block_mask`.

+  custom masks. In the FP16/BF16 support surface, combining `score_mod` with
+  built-in ALiBi, padding, causal, or sliding-window masks is not supported.

+  recent cuDNN versions and does not support every feature. In the current
+  support surface, unified SDPA requires cuDNN `>= 9.13.1`, does not support
+  dynamic shapes, supports `block_mask` starting in cuDNN `9.14`, supports
+  paged-attention inputs and sequence lengths starting in cuDNN `9.15`, and
+  supports bias, seed/offset dropout inputs, sink token, `RNG_DUMP`, `Max`, and
+  `Sum_exp` on newer versions. Custom dropout mask inputs are not supported by

+  `block_mask`.

+  due to known backend issues. cuDNN `9.14.0` has a known limitation for
+  non-causal sliding-window attention with `S_kv > 1024`.

+  newer. Decode-only mode, where `S_q == 1`, is not supported with `sink_token`
+  in the current support surface.

+# sdpa_backward
+
+Build the backward pass for scaled dot-product attention in a C++ frontend
+graph.
+
+## C++ synopsis
+
+```cpp
+std::array<std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>, 3>
+fe::graph::Graph::sdpa_backward(
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> q,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> k,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> v,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> o,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> dO,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> stats,
+    fe::graph::SDPA_backward_attributes attributes);
+```
+
+Typical use:
+
+```cpp
+auto sdpa_options = fe::graph::SDPA_backward_attributes()
+                        .set_name("sdpa_backward")
+                        .set_attn_scale(1.0f / std::sqrt(static_cast<float>(d_qk)))
+                        .set_compute_data_type(fe::DataType_t::FLOAT);
+
+auto [dQ, dK, dV] = graph->sdpa_backward(Q, K, V, O, dO, Stats, sdpa_options);
+```
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `q`, `k`, `v` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): Forward query,
+  key, and value tensors. Shape, dtype, head grouping, head-dimension
+  divisibility, and stride constraints must match the forward `sdpa` graph.
+
+- `o` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): Forward SDPA output.
+
+- `dO` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): Upstream output
+  gradient. Shape must match `o`.
+
+- `stats` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): Softmax statistics
+  from the forward `sdpa` call with `set_generate_stats(true)`. It is commonly a
+  `FLOAT` tensor with shape `{B, H_q, S_q, 1}`.
+
+- `attributes` (`fe::graph::SDPA_backward_attributes`, required): Attribute
+  object defined in `include/cudnn_frontend/graph_properties.h`.
+
+- `attributes.set_attn_scale(float or Tensor_attributes)`: Sets the same
+  attention scale used by forward.
+
+- `attributes.set_bias(...)` and `attributes.set_dbias(...)`: Set the forward
+  bias and optional bias-gradient output tensor.
+
+- `attributes.set_padding_mask(bool)`, `set_seq_len_q(...)`, and
+  `set_seq_len_kv(...)`: Configure variable-length masking. When padding mask is
+  enabled, both sequence length tensors are required.
+
+- `attributes.set_dropout(...)`: Configures the same dropout semantics as the
+  forward graph. Dropout is applied after softmax and before multiplication by
+  `V`.
+
+- `attributes.set_score_mod(...)` and score-modifier backward support: Configure
+  custom score modifier function behavior when the graph uses flexible score
+  modification.
+
+- `attributes.set_sink_token(...)` and `set_dSink_token(...)`: Set optional
+  sink-token input and sink-token gradient output.
+
+- `attributes.set_diagonal_alignment(...)`,
+  `set_diagonal_band_left_bound(...)`, and
+  `set_diagonal_band_right_bound(...)`: Preferred diagonal-band mask controls.
+  Do not combine the left-bound setter with deprecated sliding-window setters.
+
+- Deprecated mask setters: causal-mask and sliding-window convenience setters
+  remain available for compatibility, but new code should use diagonal-band
+  bounds.
+
+- `attributes.set_deterministic_algorithm(bool)`: Requests deterministic
+  backward where supported.
+
+- `attributes.set_compute_data_type(fe::DataType_t)` and
+  `attributes.set_name(std::string)`: Set compute type and operation name.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `dQ` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`): Query gradient tensor.
+
+- `dK` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`): Key gradient tensor.
+
+- `dV` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`): Value gradient tensor.
+
+Optional `dbias` and `dSink_token` outputs are tensors passed through the
+attributes object, not members of the returned array.
+
+## Errors
+
+`Graph::sdpa_backward` returns tensor attributes immediately. Mismatched forward
+metadata, invalid saved stats, unsupported masks, custom score modifiers,
+dropout, determinism requests, dtype/layout limits, and architecture limits are
+reported by lifecycle `error_t` statuses.

+## C++ synopsis

+# sdpa_mxfp8
+
+Build an MXFP8 scaled dot-product attention operation with the C++
+`Graph::sdpa_fp8` MXFP8 overload.
+
+## C++ synopsis
+
+There is no separately named `Graph::sdpa_mxfp8` method in the C++ API. Use the
+six-scale-factor overload of `Graph::sdpa_fp8`:
+
+```cpp
+std::array<std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>, 3>
+fe::graph::Graph::sdpa_fp8(
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> q,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> k,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> v,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> descale_q,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> descale_k,
+    std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes> descale_v,
+    fe::graph::SDPA_fp8_attributes attributes);
+```
+
+Typical use:
+
+```cpp
+auto sdpa_fp8_options = fe::graph::SDPA_fp8_attributes()
+                            .set_name("sdpa_fp8_mxfp8")
+                            .set_generate_stats(true)
+                            .set_attn_scale(attn_scale);
+
+auto [O, Stats, Amax_O] =
+    graph->sdpa_fp8(Q, K, V, SF_Q, SF_K, SF_V, sdpa_fp8_options);
+```
+
+The overload detects MXFP8 mode from scale-factor tensors with dtype
+`FP8_E8M0` and reordering `F8_128x4`.
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `q`, `k`, `v` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): FP8 data
+  tensors, usually `FP8_E4M3` with shape `{B, H, S, D}` and head-dimension
+  stride `1`.
+
+- `descale_q` / `SF_Q` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): MXFP8
+  block scale-factor tensor for Q. It must use dtype `FP8_E8M0`, reordering
+  `F8_128x4`, shape `{B, H, S_q_padded, D_scale_padded}`, and last stride `1`.
+
+- `descale_k` / `SF_K` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): MXFP8
+  block scale-factor tensor for K. It follows the same layout pattern as
+  `SF_Q`, with `S_kv_padded` padded to a multiple of `128`.
+
+- `descale_v` / `SF_V` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`, required): MXFP8
+  block scale-factor tensor for V. Shape is `{B, H, S_scale_padded, D_padded}`;
+  the sequence-scale dimension is the contracting dimension and must have
+  `stride[2] == 1`.
+
+- `attributes` (`fe::graph::SDPA_fp8_attributes`, required): Attribute object.
+  It is an alias of `SDPA_attributes`, defined in
+  `include/cudnn_frontend/graph_properties.h`.
+
+- `attributes.set_generate_stats(bool)`: Controls whether `Stats` is returned
+  as a real tensor.
+
+- `attributes.set_attn_scale(float or Tensor_attributes)`: Sets the score scale.
+
+- `attributes.set_diagonal_alignment`, `set_diagonal_band_left_bound`, and
+  `set_diagonal_band_right_bound`: Preferred diagonal-band controls.
+
+- Deprecated causal-mask setters: Available for compatibility. Prefer diagonal
+  band bounds for new code.
+
+- `attributes.set_sink_token(...)` and `attributes.set_unfuse_fma(bool)`: Set
+  optional sink token and SM100 softmax FMA behavior where supported.
+
+- `attributes.set_compute_data_type(fe::DataType_t)` and
+  `attributes.set_name(std::string)`: Set compute type and operation name.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `O` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`): Attention output tensor. C++
+  samples set it to `BFLOAT16`.
+
+- `Stats` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>` or `nullptr`): Softmax
+  statistics when `set_generate_stats(true)` is used.
+
+- `Amax_O` (`std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>`): Absolute maximum of the
+  output tensor.
+
+## Errors
+
+MXFP8 node creation returns tensor attributes immediately. Wrong scale-factor
+dtype or reordering, unsupported scale shapes, invalid diagonal masks, output
+metadata errors, and unsupported version or architecture are reported later by
+graph lifecycle `error_t` statuses.
+

+

+# tensor
+
+Create C++ graph tensor attributes from explicit `Tensor_attributes` metadata.
+
+## C++ synopsis
+
+```cpp
+auto X = graph->tensor(fe::graph::Tensor_attributes()
+                           .set_name("X")
+                           .set_dim({B, S, D})
+                           .set_stride({S * D, D, 1})
+                           .set_data_type(fe::DataType_t::BFLOAT16));
+```
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `Tensor_attributes` (`fe::graph::Tensor_attributes`, required): Attribute object describing logical dimensions, strides, dtype, virtual/output state, pass-by-value state, ragged offsets, reordering, name, and optional UID. `Tensor_attributes` is defined in `include/cudnn_frontend/graph_properties.h`.
+
+- `set_dim(std::vector<int64_t>)`: Sets logical tensor dimensions. The number of values is the tensor rank.
+
+- `set_stride(std::vector<int64_t>)`: Sets logical strides in elements. The rank must match `dim`.
+
+- `set_data_type(fe::DataType_t)`: Sets the tensor element type. User inputs and outputs should usually set it explicitly.
+
+- `set_is_virtual(bool)`: Marks a tensor that does not require a user-provided runtime buffer.
+
+- `set_is_pass_by_value(bool)`: Marks scalar or small runtime parameters that are passed by value through the variant pack.
+
+- `set_ragged_offset(std::shared_ptr<Tensor_attributes>)`: Sets optional packed or ragged layout offset metadata used by APIs that support ragged storage.
+
+- `set_reordering_type(fe::TensorReordering_t)`: Sets optional reordered-layout metadata. MXFP8 scale-factor tensors use `F8_128x4`.
+
+- `set_name(std::string)`: Sets the user-visible tensor name.
+
+- `set_uid(int64_t)`: Sets an explicit frontend UID. Prefer generated UIDs unless serialized or externally described graphs require fixed IDs.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `X` (`std::shared_ptr<fe::graph::Tensor_attributes>`): Tensor attributes registered as a graph input. The object can be passed to graph operations and configured further before validation.
+
+## Errors
+
+`Graph::tensor(Tensor_attributes const&)` returns tensor attributes immediately and does not return `error_t`. Metadata consistency is checked later by `Graph::validate()`, `Graph::build_operation_graph()`, support checking, and plan building.

+
+- `block_size` (`int`, required): Number of elements per quantization block along `axis`. Repository tests commonly use `32` for FP8 block-scale paths and `16` for FP4 paths.
+
+- `axis` (`int or None`, default `None`): Axis along which quantization blocks are formed. Negative axis values follow Python indexing conventions. `None` leaves the axis unset on `Block_scale_quantize_attributes`.
+
+- `transpose` (`bool`, default `False`): Requests a transposed quantized output layout when the backend supports that layout. This changes how the output and generated scale tensor should be interpreted, not the input tensor metadata.

+- `name` (`str`, default `""`): Operation name used for generated tensor names.

+

+
+## Python synopsis
+
+```python
+dX = graph.conv_dgrad(
+    loss,
+    filter,
+    padding=[],
+    stride=[],
+    dilation=[],
+    convolution_mode=cudnn.convolution_mode.CROSS_CORRELATION,
+    compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.NOT_SET,
+    name="",
+)
+
+dX = graph.conv_dgrad(
+    loss,
+    filter,
+    pre_padding=[],
+    post_padding=[],
+    stride=[],
+    dilation=[],
+    convolution_mode=cudnn.convolution_mode.CROSS_CORRELATION,
+    compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.NOT_SET,
+    name="",
+)
+```
+
+The first overload copies `padding` to both pre-padding and post-padding. Use the second overload when the two sides differ.
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `loss` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Upstream output-gradient tensor, commonly named `dY`.
+
+- `filter` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Forward filter tensor. Its channel and spatial dimensions must be compatible with `loss` and the requested input-gradient tensor metadata.
+
+- `padding` (`list[int]`, default `[]`): Symmetric spatial padding. The list length should match the number of spatial dimensions. Use this overload instead of `pre_padding` and `post_padding`.
+
+- `pre_padding` and `post_padding` (`list[int]`, default `[]`): Asymmetric spatial padding before and after each spatial dimension.
+
+- `stride` (`list[int]`, default `[]`): Spatial stride from the corresponding forward convolution.
+
+- `dilation` (`list[int]`, default `[]`): Spatial dilation from the corresponding forward convolution.
+
+- `convolution_mode` (`cudnn.convolution_mode`, default `CROSS_CORRELATION`): cuDNN convolution mode forwarded to `Conv_dgrad_attributes`.
+
+- `compute_data_type` (`cudnn.data_type`, default `NOT_SET`): Compute type. Mixed-precision examples commonly use `FLOAT` with FP16 or BF16 tensors.
+
+- `name` (`str`, default `""`): Operation name used for generated tensor names.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `dX` (`cudnn.tensor`): Input-gradient graph tensor. Data-gradient examples often set `dX` output dimensions and strides explicitly because the frontend may not infer the intended input shape from `loss` and `filter` alone.

+# matmul
+
+Append a matrix multiplication operation to a PyGraph.
+
+## Python synopsis
+
+```python
+C = graph.matmul(
+    A,
+    B,
+    compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.NOT_SET,
+    padding=0.0,
+    name="",
+)
+```
+
+For the innermost two matrix dimensions, `matmul` computes:
+
+```text
+C[..., m, n] = sum_k A[..., m, k] * B[..., k, n]
+```
+
+Leading dimensions are batch dimensions and must be compatible with the cuDNN
+backend plan selected during graph build.
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `A` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Left input tensor. The last logical dimension
+  is the contracting `K` dimension. The preceding dimension is the `M`
+  dimension. Rank-2 and batched rank-3 or higher forms are accepted when the
+  backend supports the corresponding layout.
+
+- `B` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Right input tensor. The second-to-last logical
+  dimension is the contracting `K` dimension and must match `A`'s `K`. The last
+  logical dimension is `N`.
+
+- `compute_data_type` (`cudnn.data_type`, default `NOT_SET`): Accumulation and
+  compute type for the operation. Common examples use `FLOAT` accumulation for
+  FP16, BF16, FP8, and INT8 inputs. If `NOT_SET`, the graph-level compute type is
+  used when available.
+
+- `padding` (`float`, default `0.0`): Value used by the low-level matmul
+  attributes for padded elements in layouts that require backend padding. Most
+  ordinary dense examples leave this at `0.0`.
+
+- `name` (`str`, default `""`): Operation name used to name the generated output
+  tensor.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `C` (`cudnn.tensor`): Graph tensor for the matmul output. The logical shape is
+  inferred from `A` and `B`, usually `broadcast_batch_shape + (M, N)`. Set
+  `C.set_output(True)` and an output dtype when it should be materialized in the
+  variant pack.
+
+## Raises
+
+- `TypeError`: Raised immediately when `A`, `B`, `compute_data_type`, `padding`,
+  or `name` cannot be converted to the bound C++ types.
+
+- `ValueError`: Raised by `graph.validate()` for incompatible tensor metadata,
+  invalid shape deduction, or missing output metadata required by later nodes.
+
+- `cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError`: Raised by `graph.check_support()` or
+  `graph.build_plans()` when no backend engine supports the dtype, layout,
+  alignment, architecture, or dimensions.
+

+# moe_grouped_matmul
+
+Append a mixture-of-experts grouped matmul forward operation to a PyGraph.
+
+## Python synopsis
+
+```python
+output = graph.moe_grouped_matmul(
+    token,
+    weight,
+    first_token_offset,
+    token_index=None,
+    token_ks=None,
+    mode=cudnn.moe_grouped_matmul_mode.NONE,
+    compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+    top_k=0,
+    name="",
+)
+```
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `token` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Token matrix grouped by expert. Repository tests use shape `[1, T, H]` with row-major stride `[T * H, H, 1]`.
+
+- `weight` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Expert weight tensor. Repository tests use shape `[E, H, N]` and column-major stride `[H * N, 1, H]`.
+
+- `first_token_offset` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): `INT32` tensor that gives the first token offset for each expert. Repository tests use shape `[E, 1, 1]` and stride `[1, 1, 1]`.
+
+- `token_index` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): INT32 tensor with shape `[1, routed_rows, 1]`. Required for `GATHER` and `SCATTER`; omitted for `NONE`.
+
+- `token_ks` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): INT32 routing tensor with shape `[1, routed_rows, 1]`. Required for `SCATTER` and omitted for `NONE` or `GATHER`.
+
+- `mode` (`cudnn.moe_grouped_matmul_mode`, default `NONE`): `NONE` consumes rows already grouped by expert. `GATHER` gathers source-token rows through `token_index`. `SCATTER` consumes routing metadata and scatters results using `token_index`, `token_ks`, and `top_k`.
+
+- `compute_data_type` (`cudnn.data_type`, default `FLOAT`): Compute and accumulation type. BF16 examples use `FLOAT`.
+
+- `top_k` (`int`, default `0`): Positive top-k routing value required for `SCATTER`. It is not attached to the backend descriptor for `NONE` or `GATHER`.
+
+- `name` (`str`, default `""`): Operation name.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `output` (`cudnn.tensor`): Forward grouped matmul output. The backend uses `[1, token_index.dim[1], N]` for `GATHER` and `[1, token.dim[1], N]` otherwise, with row-major stride. Before creating the graph representation, the Python IR currently exposes a provisional token-row shape for every mode; do not treat that provisional Gather dimension as authoritative.
+

+- `TypeError`: Raised immediately for invalid tensor, enum, integer, or name arguments.
+
+- `ValueError`: Raised by Python argument or graph metadata checks for malformed declared shapes, strides, modes, or output metadata. Runtime values such as offset monotonicity and index ranges are caller-owned data contracts and are not exhaustively inspected by `graph.validate()`.
+
+- `cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError`: Raised by support checking or plan building when the dtype, architecture, expert layout, or mode is unsupported.
+

+# sdpa
+
+Build a scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) operation in a cuDNN frontend graph.
+
+## Python synopsis
+
+```python
+o, stats = graph.sdpa(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    attn_scale=None,
+    bias=None,
+    block_mask=None,
+    use_alibi_mask=False,
+    use_padding_mask=False,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    dropout=None,
+    rng_dump=None,
+    paged_attention_k_table=None,
+    paged_attention_v_table=None,
+    paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv=None,
+    compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.NOT_SET,
+    name="",
+    generate_stats=None,
+    implementation=cudnn.attention_implementation.AUTO,
+    score_mod=None,
+    score_max=None,
+    score_sum_exp=None,
+    sink_token=None,
+    unfuse_fma=False,
+    diagonal_alignment=cudnn.diagonal_alignment.TOP_LEFT,
+    diagonal_band_left_bound=None,
+    diagonal_band_right_bound=None,
+    sliding_window_length=None,
+    use_causal_mask=False,
+    use_causal_mask_bottom_right=False,
+    is_inference=None,
+)
+```
+
+`sdpa` computes:
+
+```text
+scores = matmul(q, transpose(k))
+scores = scores * attn_scale              # only when attn_scale is provided
+scores = score_mod(scores)                # optional
+scores = scores + bias                    # optional
+scores = scores + alibi / diagonal mask   # optional additive term
+scores = scores + padding mask            # optional additive term
+stats = logsumexp(scores)                 # only when generate_stats=True
+probs = softmax(scores)
+probs = dropout(probs)                    # optional; applied after softmax
+o = matmul(probs, v)
+```
+
+Equivalently, with optional score modifier function $f$, additive bias $B$,
+optional additive ALiBi/diagonal mask term $M_d$, and optional additive padding
+mask term $M_p$:
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+S &= QK^\top, \\
+\hat{S} &= f\left(\alpha S\right) + B + M_d + M_p, \\
+\operatorname{Stats} &= \operatorname{logsumexp}\left(\hat{S}\right), \\
+P &= \operatorname{softmax}\left(\hat{S}\right), \\
+\tilde{P} &= \operatorname{dropout}\left(P\right), \\
+O &= \tilde{P}V.
+\end{aligned}
+$$
+
+Here $\alpha$ is `attn_scale` when provided; otherwise the multiplication by
+$\alpha$ is omitted. $\operatorname{Stats}$ is generated only when
+`generate_stats=True`; its `logsumexp` reduction is taken over the last score
+dimension, corresponding to the key/value sequence positions. Terms for disabled
+options are omitted. Additive mask terms use `0` for retained scores and a large
+negative value or negative infinity for masked scores. When dropout is disabled,
+$\tilde{P} = P$; when enabled, dropout is applied to the softmax probabilities
+before the multiplication by $V$.
+
+The operation appends nodes to `graph` and returns graph tensor attributes. It does
+not execute immediately; validate, build, and execute the graph in the usual
+PyGraph workflow.
+
+## Parameters
+
+Core parameters:
+
+- `q` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Query tensor. Must be 4-D with logical shape
+  `(B, H_q, S_q, D_qk)`. The last stride, corresponding to head dimension, must
+  be `1`. For the FP16/BF16 `sdpa` path, `D_qk` must be a multiple of `8`.
+  See Notes for architecture- and cuDNN-version-specific maximums.
+
+- `k` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Key tensor. Usually shape
+  `(B, H_k, S_kv, D_qk)`. With paged attention, this is the key-cache container
+  rather than the logical dense K tensor. Its head dimension must match `q`'s
+  `D_qk`, which must be a multiple of `8` for the FP16/BF16 path. See Notes for
+  architecture- and cuDNN-version-specific maximums.
+
+- `v` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Value tensor. Usually shape
+  `(B, H_v, S_kv, D_v)`. With paged attention, this is the value-cache
+  container. For the FP16/BF16 `sdpa` path, `D_v` must be a multiple of `8`.
+  See Notes for architecture- and cuDNN-version-specific maximums.
+
+- `attn_scale` (`float`, `cudnn.tensor`, or `None`, default `None`): Optional
+  scale multiplied into the attention scores after `Q @ K.T`. cuDNN does not
+  infer `1 / sqrt(D_qk)`; pass it explicitly when desired. If a tensor is used,
+  it must be a graph tensor, commonly scalar-shaped and pass-by-value.
+
+- `bias` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional additive score
+  bias broadcast-compatible with `(B, H_q, S_q, S_kv)`, commonly
+  `(1, H_q, S_q, S_kv)` or `(B, 1, S_q, S_kv)`. Boolean bias tensors are not
+  supported. Use `bias`, rather than `block_mask`, for an arbitrary per-score
+  floating-point mask: use `0` for retained scores and a large negative value
+  or negative infinity for masked scores.
+
+- `block_mask` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional packed block
+  mask input. The common tile form is `UINT8` with shape
+  `(B, H_q, ceil(S_q / 128), ceil(ceil(S_kv / 128) / 8))`. Requires an
+  implementation/version that supports block masks. Do not force
+  `implementation=cudnn.attention_implementation.COMPOSITE` when `block_mask` is
+  provided; the composite implementation does not support `block_mask`. This is
+  a binary tile-visibility mask, not an arbitrary per-score floating-point mask.
+  On SM10x, unified SDPA block masks require cuDNN 9.26 or newer because older
+  backends have a masked-tile initialization bug.
+
+- `use_alibi_mask` (`bool`, default `False`): Adds ALiBi score offsets. In the
+  FP16/BF16 support surface, ALiBi requires `diagonal_band_right_bound=0`.
+
+- `use_padding_mask` (`bool`, default `False`): Enables variable sequence length
+  masking. Requires both `seq_len_q` and `seq_len_kv`.
+
+- `seq_len_q` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Actual query sequence
+  lengths, normally `INT32` shape `(B, 1, 1, 1)`. Used with
+  `use_padding_mask=True`, paged attention, ragged layouts, or custom score
+  modifiers that need sequence lengths.
+
+- `seq_len_kv` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Actual key/value
+  sequence lengths, normally `INT32` shape `(B, 1, 1, 1)`. Used with
+  `use_padding_mask=True`, paged attention, ragged layouts, or custom score
+  modifiers that need sequence lengths.
+
+- `dropout` (`tuple` or `None`, default `None`): Optional dropout. Must be
+  either a 3-element tuple
+  `(probability: float, seed: cudnn.tensor, offset: cudnn.tensor)` for
+  internally generated Philox dropout, or a 2-element tuple
+  `(mask: cudnn.tensor, scale: cudnn.tensor)` for a custom dropout mask.
+
+- `rng_dump` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional output tensor
+  for dumping the generated dropout RNG mask. Used only with probability-based
+  dropout. Its shape should match the attention score matrix,
+  `(B, H_q, S_q, S_kv)`, or `(B, H_q, S_q, paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv)` when
+  paged attention uses an explicit maximum KV length. The usual contiguous
+  stride is `(H_q * S_q * S_kv, S_q * S_kv, S_kv, 1)`, with `S_kv` replaced by
+  `paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv` for paged attention. The data type should be
+  `cudnn.data_type.FLOAT`.
+
+- `paged_attention_k_table` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional
+  page table for looking up blocks in the key-cache container. Page table values
+  are `INT32` block indices.
+
+- `paged_attention_v_table` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional
+  page table for looking up blocks in the value-cache container. Page table
+  values are `INT32` block indices.
+
+- `paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv` (`int` or `None`, default `None`): Logical
+  maximum KV sequence length when paged attention is active. Optional in some
+  cases, but recommended because it removes inference ambiguity. Do not specify
+  this parameter unless `paged_attention_k_table` or `paged_attention_v_table` is
+  provided.
+
+- `compute_data_type` (`cudnn.data_type`, default `NOT_SET`): Compute type for
+  this operation. When `NOT_SET`, the graph-level compute type is used. For the
+  unified implementation, compute type must be `FLOAT`.
+
+- `name` (`str`, default `""`): Operation name used to name generated tensors,
+  for example `"<name>::O"` and `"<name>::Stats"`.
+
+- `generate_stats` (`bool` or `None`, default `None`): Whether to create the
+  softmax statistics tensor required by SDPA backward. Exactly one of
+  `generate_stats` and deprecated `is_inference` must be provided. Use `True`
+  for training and `False` for inference.
+
+- `implementation` (`cudnn.attention_implementation`, default `AUTO`): Selects
+  the attention implementation. `AUTO` chooses a supported `COMPOSITE` or
+  `UNIFIED` path. The explicit choices have different feature, version, and
+  architecture support surfaces.
+
+- `score_mod` (callable or `None`, default `None`): Optional callback
+  `score_mod(sdpa_graph, score_tensor) -> cudnn.tensor` that inserts a custom
+  score-modification subgraph before softmax. In the FP16/BF16 support surface,
+  do not combine `score_mod` with the built-in ALiBi, padding, causal, or
+  sliding-window masking parameters.
+
+- `score_max` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional user-provided
+  output tensor for the softmax logit maximum. Shape is normally
+  `(B, H_q, S_q, 1)`, type `FLOAT`. It is filled through the graph execution
+  variant pack and is not returned by `sdpa`.
+
+- `score_sum_exp` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional
+  user-provided output tensor for the numerically stable sum of exponentials.
+  Shape is normally `(B, H_q, S_q, 1)`, type `FLOAT`. It is filled through the
+  graph execution variant pack and is not returned by `sdpa`.
+
+- `sink_token` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional
+  sink-attention token tensor. Shape is `(1, H_q, 1, 1)`, type `FLOAT`.
+
+- `unfuse_fma` (`bool`, default `False`): SM100 softmax option. When `True`,
+  uses unfused `__fmul_rn` plus `__fadd_rn` instead of fused FMA in selected
+  softmax paths.
+
+Preferred masking parameters:
+
+- `diagonal_alignment` (`cudnn.diagonal_alignment`, default `TOP_LEFT`):
+  Alignment used by diagonal band masks. `TOP_LEFT` is the standard prefill
+  alignment. `BOTTOM_RIGHT` is used for bottom-right aligned decode masks.
+
+- `diagonal_band_left_bound` (`int` or `None`, default `None`): Optional left
+  sliding-window bound. Values are offsets to the left of the main diagonal that
+  remain visible. `None` means no left bound. Do not specify this together with
+  the deprecated `sliding_window_length`; they configure the same left-bound
+  masking behavior.
+
+- `diagonal_band_right_bound` (`int` or `None`, default `None`): Optional right
+  diagonal bound. `0` with `TOP_LEFT` alignment is the preferred causal-mask
+  spelling. `None` means no right bound. Do not specify this together with the
+  deprecated `use_causal_mask` or `use_causal_mask_bottom_right`; those
+  parameters also set the right bound to `0`.
+
+Deprecated parameters:
+
+- `sliding_window_length` (`int` or `None`, default `None`): Deprecated.
+  Equivalent to `diagonal_band_left_bound`. Cannot be combined with an explicit
+  left bound.
+
+- `use_causal_mask` (`bool`, default `False`): Deprecated. Equivalent to
+  `diagonal_alignment=TOP_LEFT` and `diagonal_band_right_bound=0`. Cannot be
+  combined with `use_causal_mask_bottom_right` or an explicit right bound.
+
+- `use_causal_mask_bottom_right` (`bool`, default `False`): Deprecated.
+  Equivalent to `diagonal_alignment=BOTTOM_RIGHT` and
+  `diagonal_band_right_bound=0`. Cannot be combined with `use_causal_mask` or an
+  explicit right bound.
+
+- `is_inference` (`bool` or `None`, default `None`): Deprecated compatibility
+  option. `is_inference=False` maps to `generate_stats=True`;
+  `is_inference=True` maps to `generate_stats=False`. Prefer `generate_stats`.
+  Exactly one of `is_inference` and `generate_stats` must be specified.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `o` (`cudnn.tensor`): Output tensor attributes for the attention result. The
+  logical output shape is `(B, H_q, S_q, D_v)`, where `D_v` must be a multiple
+  of `8` for the FP16/BF16 `sdpa` path. See Notes for architecture- and
+  cuDNN-version-specific maximums. The returned tensor is virtual until it is
+  marked as a graph output with `o.set_output(True)`. Set its dimensions,
+  strides, data type, and UID as needed before graph validation/build.
+
+- `stats` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`): Softmax statistics tensor. Present only
+  when `generate_stats=True`; otherwise `None`. The usual shape is
+  `(B, H_q, S_q, 1)`, type `FLOAT`. These statistics are required by
+  `sdpa_backward`.
+

+# sdpa_backward
+
+Build the backward pass for scaled dot-product attention in a cuDNN frontend
+PyGraph.
+
+## Python synopsis
+
+```python
+dQ, dK, dV = graph.sdpa_backward(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    o,
+    dO,
+    stats,
+    *,
+    attn_scale=None,
+    bias=None,
+    dbias=None,
+    use_padding_mask=False,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    dropout=None,
+    rng_dump=None,
+    compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.NOT_SET,
+    name="",
+    implementation=cudnn.attention_implementation.AUTO,
+    score_mod=None,
+    score_mod_bprop=None,
+    sink_token=None,
+    dSink_token=None,
+    diagonal_alignment=cudnn.diagonal_alignment.TOP_LEFT,
+    diagonal_band_left_bound=None,
+    diagonal_band_right_bound=None,
+    use_causal_mask=False,
+    use_causal_mask_bottom_right=False,
+    sliding_window_length=None,
+    use_deterministic_algorithm=False,
+)
+```
+
+`sdpa_backward` differentiates the same attention computation built by
+`sdpa`. The forward graph must have generated `stats` and the backward graph
+must use matching score modifiers, masks, dropout configuration, attention
+scale, and sequence lengths.
+
+```text
+scores = matmul(q, transpose(k))
+scores = scores * attn_scale              # only when provided
+scores = score_mod(scores)                # optional forward score modifier function
+scores = scores + bias + masks            # optional additive terms
+probs = softmax(scores, stats=stats)
+probs = dropout(probs)                    # optional; same position as forward
+o = matmul(probs, v)
+
+dQ, dK, dV = backward(o, dO, stats, q, k, v)
+dbias = optional score-bias gradient
+dSink_token = optional sink-token gradient
+```
+
+In equation form, the backward call differentiates $O = \tilde{P}V$, where
+$\tilde{P} = \operatorname{dropout}(\operatorname{softmax}(\hat{S}))$ and
+$\hat{S}$ is the masked, biased, optionally modified score tensor documented by
+`sdpa`.
+
+$$
+(dQ, dK, dV) =
+\nabla_{Q,K,V}\; O\left(Q,K,V,\operatorname{Stats},dO\right)
+$$
+
+The optional `score_mod_bprop` callback supplies the derivative of the forward
+score modifier function. Optional `dbias` and `dSink_token` tensors receive
+additional gradients but are not part of the returned tuple.
+
+## Parameters
+
+- `q`, `k`, `v` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Forward query, key, and value
+  tensors. Shapes, dtypes, head grouping, head-dimension divisibility, stride
+  constraints, and architecture limits must match the forward `sdpa` graph.
+
+- `o` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Forward SDPA output tensor. It must have the
+  same logical shape and dtype as the forward output used to compute `dO`.
+
+- `dO` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Upstream gradient for `o`. Its shape must
+  match `o`. It may use its own supported stride.
+
+- `stats` (`cudnn.tensor`, required): Forward softmax statistics returned by
+  `sdpa` when `generate_stats=True`. Usually shape `(B, H_q, S_q, 1)` and dtype
+  `FLOAT`. The values must correspond to the same forward options used by this
+  backward graph.
+
+- `attn_scale` (`float`, `cudnn.tensor`, or `None`, default `None`): Same
+  attention scale used by the forward graph.
+
+- `bias` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Same forward additive bias
+  tensor when the forward graph used bias.
+
+- `dbias` (`cudnn.tensor` or `None`, default `None`): Optional output tensor for
+  additive bias gradients. Keep and map this tensor in the variant pack because
+  it is not returned by `sdpa_backward`.
+

+  padding mask used by forward. Requires both `seq_len_q` and `seq_len_kv`.

+  `(mask, scale)`. Dropout is applied to softmax probabilities before the
+  multiplication by `V`; backward must use the same mask or Philox seed/offset
+  stream as forward.

+

+- `use_deterministic_algorithm` (`bool`, default `False`): Requests a
+  deterministic backward algorithm where the backend supports one.
+
+Deprecated masking parameters:
+
+- `use_causal_mask` (`bool`, default `False`): Deprecated causal-mask shortcut.
+  Prefer `diagonal_band_right_bound=0` with the appropriate
+  `diagonal_alignment`.
+
+- `use_causal_mask_bottom_right` (`bool`, default `False`): Deprecated
+  bottom-right causal-mask shortcut. Prefer
+  `diagonal_alignment=cudnn.diagonal_alignment.BOTTOM_RIGHT` with

+
+- `sliding_window_length` (`int` or `None`, default `None`): Deprecated sliding
+  window shortcut. Prefer `diagonal_band_left_bound`.
+
+## Returns
+
+- `dQ` (`cudnn.tensor`): Gradient tensor for `q`. Shape follows `q`.
+
+- `dK` (`cudnn.tensor`): Gradient tensor for `k`. Shape follows `k`.
